title: Society And Culture (750-1200 AD)
definition: The Early Medieval period represents a transition from the classical Gupta-Vakataka model to a decentralized, feudal, and regionalized socio-cultural structure characterized by the proliferation of castes and the rise of temple-centric urbanism.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the evolution of Indian feudalism, the 'Kalivarjya' concept, and the synthesis of regional identities that define modern Indian cultural geography.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Society And Culture.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of Land Grant economy (Agrahara)
